attacks.name: Yaka Arrow
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
The defender does not benefit from Cover.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: Whistle While You Work
steps: |!wild| |*Pierce|: Change 1 of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

|!wild| |!hit| |*Yaka Mastery|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Whistle While You Work| attack without paying the |!power| cost. This attack must target another character within |!range| 3 of the original target character and any distance from this character that has not been targeted by a |*Whistle While You Work| attack this Round.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character makes an attack action followed immediately by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ravager Code: Steal Everything
superPowers.body: When a character within |!range| 2 of this character would drop 1 or more objective tokens, this character may use this superpower. Move 1 objective token that character would drop to this character. This character is now holding that token. This character may not hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.

superPowers.name: Quickdraw
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack and the attacker is not within |!range| 2 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Instead of rolling dice equal to its Defense, it rolls 5 defense dice. Then, if this character suffers no |!damage| from the attack, after the attack is resolved, the attacker suffers 2 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: The Pirate Way
superPowers.body: While this character is holding 1 or more objective tokens or Contesting a Secure objective, it may reroll 1 die in its attack and defense rolls.
